news.title:
Nuvama Wealth and Investment Ltd redeemed its commercial paper under ISIN INE523L14BE3.
The redemption was based on the offer document dated February 27, 2026.

Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd redeemed commercial papers (ISIN: INE531F14FS9) issued under March 2026 offer document.
Redemption details were communicated to BSE; payment obligations have been fulfilled as informed by the company.
NUVAMA: Interim Dividend And Board Decisions Will Support Steady Fair Value View
news.body: Analysts have kept the Nuvama Wealth Management price target unchanged at ₹1,630. They have made only small refinements to assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, which help support their existing valuation stance.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 8 experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Kamlesh Vikamsey was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: NUVAMA: Board Actions And Interim Dividend Will Support Steady Fair Value View
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Nuvama Wealth Management from ₹1,485 to ₹1,630, citing updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as key drivers of the change. What's in the News Nuvama Wealth Management scheduled a Board Meeting on May 19, 2026 at 12:30 Indian Standard Time to consider appointing M/s.

news.title: Price target increased by 8.7% to ₹1,840
news.body: Up from ₹1,693, the current price target is an average from 8 analysts. New target price is 21% above last closing price of ₹1,519. Stock is up 13% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹67.77 for next year compared to ₹57.59 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹57.59 (vs ₹55.33 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹57.59 (up from ₹55.33 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹36.7b (up 8.7% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹10.4b (up 5.6% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 28% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 8.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India.

news.title: NUVAMA: Board Review And Dividend Decision Will Reinforce Steady Fair Value View
news.body: Analysts have maintained their ₹1,485 price target on Nuvama Wealth Management, citing slightly updated assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E that offset each other overall. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for May 11, 2026, to review audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 (company filing).

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 23%
news.body: After last week's 23% share price gain to ₹1,632, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 26x. Average forward P/E is 31x in the Capital Markets industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 40% over the past year.

news.title: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited to Report Q4, 2026 Results on May 11, 2026
news.body: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited announced that they will report Q4, 2026 results on May 11, 2026

news.title: NUVAMA: Board Results Will Frame Margins And Support Steady Fair Value View
news.body: Analysts have maintained the price target for Nuvama Wealth Management at ₹1,485. The latest update reflects slightly higher revenue growth assumptions, a modestly lower profit margin, and a small adjustment to the forward P/E and discount rate.

news.title: NUVAMA: Upcoming January Results Will Support Bullish Long Term Reassessment
news.body: The analyst price target for Nuvama Wealth Management is maintained at ₹1,750.13, with only minor tweaks to inputs such as the discount rate and assumed future P/E. Analysts see this as reflecting small refinements to their valuation framework rather than a change in conviction.

news.title: NUVAMA: Upcoming Board Results Will Support Constructive Forward Margin View
news.body: Analysts have kept the price target for Nuvama Wealth Management steady at ₹1,485, citing updated assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that broadly support the existing valuation view. What's in the News Nuvama Wealth Management has scheduled a board meeting for January 23, 2026, to review and approve its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: NUVAMA: Upcoming Results And Margin Outlook Will Support Constructive Forward View
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target on Nuvama Wealth Management from ₹1,380 to ₹1,485, citing updated assumptions that include a slightly lower discount rate, modest adjustments to revenue growth expectations, and a higher projected profit margin, while keeping a similar forward P/E multiple. What's in the News Nuvama Wealth Management has scheduled a board meeting for January 23, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: NUVAMA: Upcoming Results Review Will Reinforce Bullish Longer Term Reassessment
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Nuvama Wealth Management from ₹1,778.88 to ₹1,750.13. This reflects updates to their assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E.

news.title: NUVAMA: Upcoming Board Results Meeting Will Support Bullish Reassessment
news.body: Analysts have reset their price target for Nuvama Wealth Management from ₹8,639.63 to ₹1,778.88. This reflects updated assumptions for slightly higher revenue growth and profit margins, along with a modestly lower discount rate and future P/E expectations.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates increase by 15%, revenue downgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 revenue forecast fell from ₹31.3b to ₹30.8b. EPS estimate rose from ₹49.86 to ₹57.37. Net income forecast to grow 14% next year vs 23% growth forecast for Capital Markets industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹1,712 to ₹1,779. Share price was steady at ₹1,345 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹14.02 (vs ₹14.08 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.02. Revenue: ₹8.62b (up 6.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.54b (flat on 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 30% (down from 31% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India.

news.title: NUVAMA: Stock Split And Capital Changes Will Shape Measured Forward Outlook
news.body: Analysts kept their fair value estimate for Nuvama Wealth Management steady at ₹1,380.00, citing only modest adjustments to discount rate assumptions, revenue growth forecasts, profit margin expectations and future P/E inputs. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on Jan 23, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited Announces Executive Changes, Effective February 1, 2026
news.body: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited appointed Mr. Keyur Ajmera as Group Chief Risk Officer of the Company in place of Mr. Venkataraman Ananthakrishnan, who will transit from his current role and will be assuming a new senior leadership role at Nuvama Group level effective February 1, 2026. Consequently, Mr. Ananthakrishnan will cease to be Senior Management Personnel and Mr. Keyur Ajmera will be designated as SMP. Mr. Keyur Ajmera is a seasoned Risk professional with more than 18 years of Risk Management experience in financial services industry across Non-bank lending, Retail and Institutional Broking, Clearing and Custody, Wealth Management, Asset Management, Proprietary trading and Hedge funds. news.title: NUVAMA: Stock Split And Capital Changes Will Shape Measured Forward Outlook
news.body: Analysts have reduced their price target on Nuvama Wealth Management from ₹1,480 to ₹1,380, citing revised assumptions regarding discount rates, expected revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E levels. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for Nov 04, 2025 to review unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended Sep 30, 2025, consider an interim dividend for FY 2025-26, and review a proposal to alter the share capital of the company (company filing).

news.title: NUVAMA: Stock Split And Mutual Fund Expansion Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have revised their price target for Nuvama Wealth Management sharply lower from ₹7,300 to ₹1,480. This reflects more conservative assumptions on revenue growth and valuation multiples, partly offset by a slightly lower discount rate and an improved profit margin outlook.
